title: Change password
purpose: Replace the password for your signed-in account.
summary: Change the password of the account you are signed in with. Your roles and the records you can see stay the same.

tasks.title: Change your password
steps: Enter the new password in [[New Password]] and again in [[New Password (again)]].
Select [[Change Password]]. You stay signed in on this browser.

tasks.title: Get in when you have forgotten your password
steps: Select [[Forgot your password?]] to see the recovery options for this laboratory.

good_to_know: Other browsers or devices signed in with the old password stop working.
Changing your password does not reset your authenticator app or recovery codes.
A new password needs at least 15 characters, or 8 if the laboratory requires a second sign-in factor of your account. The form states which.

sections.title: Page variants
paragraphs: For a signed-in user changing their own password. Accounts without a usable password are redirected to Set Password. This is not the administrator form for another user’s password.

items.label: Current Password
items.description: Required existing password for this signed-in account.

items.label: New Password
items.description: Required new password. The help under it states the rule for this account: at least 15 characters, or 8 where the laboratory's second sign-in factor rule covers the account, read again when you save. Refused: a common password; a common password or a name of the laboratory, the application or the account with only digits, symbols, spaces or letter case changed; one character or a short text repeated; a run such as 123456789 or qwertyuiop; a password too similar to the username, names or email address. The whole password is compared, so a passphrase containing a common word is accepted. Any character, spaces included, counts, and there is no upper limit or required kind of character.

items.label: New Password (again)
items.description: Required identical repeat of the new password.

items.label: Change Password
items.description: Saves after validation, preserves this browser’s signed-in session and returns to Change Password with a success message. Other sessions using the old password hash cease to authenticate. Laboratory roles, capabilities and client ownership are unchanged.

items.label: Forgot your password?
items.description: Opens the email recovery form under Current Password. When outgoing email is off, recovery instructions direct you to the laboratory administrator.

items.label: Account navigation
items.description: Uses the staff or client shell. Change password and Two-factor authentication open their respective settings; Sign out posts immediate sign-out.

sections.title: Limits
paragraphs: Changing your password does not reset an enrolled authenticator or recovery codes. The committed configuration does not send security-notification emails for password changes. No password-value audit record is created by these self-service pages; administrator changes of another user’s password use the separately audited maintenance form.
